# @rnw-community/nestjs-typed-config

> NestJS typed configuration with full TypeScript support: an enum of environment variable names, an interface of their
> types, and a `joi` validation schema produce a typed, cached config service. Peer dependencies: `@nestjs/common`,
> `@nestjs/config`, and `joi`.

Extend the service class returned by `NestJSTypedConfigModule.create` and wire the returned module into your own
config module. Variables whose name ends with `_FILE` are read from the file path they contain.

## Landing

- [readme.md](readme.md): Installation, exports, configuration setup, usage, and file-backed variables.

## Guides

- [Configuration](readme.md#configuration): Defining the variables enum, types interface, joi schema, and the project config module.
- [Usage](readme.md#usage): Injecting the extended config service and reading typed values with `get`.
- [Reading values from files](readme.md#reading-values-from-files): `_FILE`-suffixed variables resolved to the trimmed contents of the referenced file.

## API reference

- [`NestJSTypedConfigModule`](readme.md#nestjstypedconfigmodule): `create<Enum, Config>(validationSchema)` returns a `[DynamicModule, ServiceClass]` tuple backed by a global, cached `ConfigModule.forRoot`.
- [`NestJSTypedConfigService`](readme.md#nestjstypedconfigservice): Injectable service whose `get(envVariable)` returns the typed value, caching lookups and reading `_FILE` variables from disk.

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/rnw-community/blob/master/packages/nestjs-typed-config/AGENTS.md): Package commands, architecture, key patterns, dependencies, and coverage.
